## Current-main triage (2026-11-04)

**Issue remains open.** Re-checked at `origin/main` `ece818d386cebcacfdb591e1d41695036d211d43` in `/home/user/git/fleet/7941`. The CodeDB per-root text index for that checkout (`~/.codedb/projects/591f7e6993f5893f`) indexes `infra/dns/dns_config.yaml` (YAML, 1238 indexed lines); `codedb search 'monday.mxrouting.net'` returns `infra/dns/dns_config.yaml:4`. This proves CodeDB full-text/trigram coverage on current main.

It does **not** prove embedding in a semantic/vector sidecar: the store contains the snapshot and text indexes but no semantic sidecar, and `codedb semantic-index` failed with `EmbeddingProviderRejected`. The repository also does not identify an authoritative fleet-wide semantic-index owner or manifest.

The earlier carried recommendation to close this based on trigram search was too strong. Keep this issue open until the canonical index/owner and an accepted embedding path are identified, then either verify the file in that index or link a follow-up in the owning repo/system. Suggested order: (1) identify canonical index and owner/provider, (2) build or refresh its semantic sidecar, (3) verify the file entry and update this issue.
